title: Ticket
description: Proof of certain right to transport or services associated with it.

itinerary.description: Sequence of Locations for which the Ticket is valid. Typically the two consecutive Locations between which one can travel with the Ticket, for example a train season ticket between Brussels and Ghent (where the type of Ticket is usually "return ticket", i.e. a Trip from Ghent to Brussels is also possible). But it can also simply be the Area or Place to which the Ticket applies, for example Antwerp. Lijst van Location items.
